options.text: All evidence obtained by any government mistake must be suppressed in every proceeding in the present case.
options.misconception: assumes the rule always applies

options.text: Suppressing evidence requires the court to find the defendant innocent in this situation.
options.misconception: confuses suppression with acquittal
